Bug_Explanation: The code sets up equality groups using EqualsTester but does not call the terminating method testEquals() to actually perform the equality checks, resulting in the test setup having no effect.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case uses the method showBug from the EqualityChecker class, which demonstrates the MissingTestCall bug by not calling the testEquals() method on the EqualsTester instance. This omission triggers the bug.
